questions.q_en:
A question is given followed by two statements (I) and (II). You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements is sufficient to answer the question. Read both the statements and select the appropriate answer.

Question: Eight persons are sitting around two concentric square tables. A, B, C and D are sitting on the edges of outer table facing inside. P, Q, R and S are sitting on the edges on inner table facing outside. The persons sitting on outer table are facing the persons sitting on inner table. Who is facing B?

Statements:

(I) A is facing R. Q is not neighbour of R. S is not facing B.

(II) C is facing P. Q is to the immediate right of P.
options_en: Data in statement I and statement II together is not sufficient to answer the question
Data in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement I is not
Data in statement I and statement II together is sufficient to answer the question
Data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement II is not
questions.solution_en:
Eight persons are sitting around two concentric square tables. A, B, C and D are sitting on the edges of outer table. P, Q, R and S are sitting on the edges on inner table.

The persons sitting on outer table are facing the persons sitting on inner table.

Statement I: A is facing R. Q is not neighbour of R. S is not facing B.

The position of B is not confirmed.

So, statement I is not sufficient.

Statement II: C is facing P. Q is to the immediate right of P.

The position of B is not confirmed.

So, statement II alone is not sufficient.

By combining I and II:

So, Q faces B.

Thus, statement I and II together are sufficient.

questions.q_en: Sterling starts cycling from his home towards South at 6 am. At every interval of 15 minutes he takes a left turn and continues to cycle in the new direction, for the next 15 minutes. What direction would he be cycling in at 10:50 a.m. that day?
questions.solution_en:
Time interval between 6 a.m. and 10:45 a.m. = 4 hours 45 minutes = 285 minutes.

Since Sterling took left turns at intervals of 15 minutes in all he must have taken 19 left turns in total, the last one being at 10:45 a.m.

Now, we know that 4 successive left turns leads to Sterling cycling in the same direction, so after the 16th left turn he must have still been cycling South-wards.

Thus after the 19th turn, at 10:45 a.m., Sterling must be cycling West-wards. So, at 10:50 am, he will Sterling will be facing West-wards

questions.solution_en:

Option (b): K = B: K ≥ L > M = B. So, this is false as K will be '>' than B not equal to.

Option (c): G < M: G < J = K ≥ L > M. So, this is false as all the signs are not in the same direction.

Option (d): B < J: J = K ≥ L > M = B. So, this is true.

So, option (d) is the correct answer.

= 75 + 18 - 3

= 93 - 3

= 90. So, option (a) is incorrect.

Option (b) 22 - 11 + 2 ÷ 13 x 4 = 173

= 22 - 11 + 0.615

= 22.615 - 11

= 11.615

So, option (b) is incorrect.

Option (c) 73 + 89 - 54 ÷ 6 x 12 = 54

= 73 + 89 - 108

= 162 - 108

= 54. So, option (c) is correct.

Option (d) 42 ÷ 19 x 26 + 2 - 4 = 29

= 57.47 + 2 - 4

= 59.47 - 4

= 55.47

So, option (d) is incorrect.

questions.q_en: P, Q, R, S, T and U sit in a linear row to play a game. No two adjacent people face in the same direction. Some of them face north whereas the rest of them face south direction. Three people sit between P and S. R sits immediately left of P. P and S both faces in the south direction. Q sits immediately right of S. U does not sit at the extreme ends of the row. T sits adjacent to P. Then, how many people sit between T and Q?
questions.solution_en:
P, Q, R, S, T and U sit in a linear row to play a game. No two adjacent people face in the same direction. Some of them face north whereas the rest of them face south direction. Three people sit between P and S. R sits immediately left of P. P and S both faces in the south direction. So, there are two cases possible i.e., Case 1 and Case 2.

Q sits immediately right of S. U does not sit at the extreme ends of the row. T sits adjacent to P. So, Case 2 will be invalid.

So, three people sit between T and Q.
